answer: Locks are written down in island, expire in dune, and plume lists each expiry. The admission bond is time locked for 27 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. Anyone running 87 aliases therefore needs 98 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. A farm of 2918 identities would post 4105 proofs and burn roughly 19 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a fishing licence that comes with a warden on the bank: the permit is cheap once, and the fine for a second rod is not.
